explanation: One round of the new check, every 10 minutes. The key step is the last check before saving: a number from a running agent always wins. It leaves out failures, which just keep the old number.

events.label: Hub picks idle accounts
events.detail: Signed in, not paused, no agent running on it. Claude and Codex only

events.label: Ask the account's own CLI
events.detail: Claude: /usage. Codex: its rate-limit read. Neither sends a message, so no quota is spent

events.label: Still idle? Save the number
events.detail: Dropped if an agent started on the account meanwhile

events.label: Uses it like any other reading
events.detail: Waiting starts are retried at once
